user.title: Connect to the scanner container
user.description: Address of the BrotherScannerDocker web interface. Host may also be a full URL such as {example_https} or {example_http}. Leave the port empty for 80, or 443 with HTTPS. The API token is only needed when the container runs with API_TOKEN.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The container refused the API token. Enter the current API_TOKEN of the container.

error.cannot_connect: The container did not answer: {detail}. Check host, port, HTTPS and that WEBSERVER=true is set.
error.invalid_auth: The container rejected the API token.
error.unsupported_api: The container speaks a newer API than this integration. Update the integration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error: {detail}. See the log for details.
error.api_error: The address answered, but not with the container's API: {detail}. The web interface must be at the root of this address; check host, port and HTTPS (a reverse proxy answers 404 page not found when the name or port is wrong).

data.image_url: Picture URL for the card (empty: generic illustration by model)
data.hide_image: Hide the picture on the card

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Starts a scan on the container and returns the job id.

source.description: Paper source as the device lists it, e.g. FlatBed.

wait.name: Wait

scan_rear.description: Scans the rear pages of the job that waits for them.

job.name: Job

device_id.description: Which scanner, when more than one is configured.
